source: Existing native IID DCP phase packets, contrasted with the existing injective full-function hidden-shift oracle model. No new toy promise.

local_results.native_packet_gap: For nonzero difference, mean squared orbit overlap2^-r. Failure of overlap<=alpha anywhere has source probability upper(N-1)*2^-r/alpha^2. This is information, not a receiver or hardness theorem.
local_results.cyclic_order: Conjugate lift retains image orderN/gcd(N,K), not exponent two in generic native packets.
local_results.task: All unrestricted native isomorphism decisions are YES for every s; a witness/search reduction is separate.
local_results.access: Finite native packets do not supply a classical preparation circuit or reusable preparation/inverse. Exact deterministic reflection programming from the stated finite nonorthogonal copy programs fails; approximate/heralded methods are not excluded.
local_results.full_function_lane: Two selector-XOR queries prepare the real double-graph coherent lift; two invert it. Its exact reflection at gap1 retains the full standard right-coset shift under the known sign map t=-s; the target group remains nonabelian dihedral.
local_results.literature_correction: The existing generic phase-sieve/Gowers attribution was OUR extraction error and is corrected. No source paper is refuted.

proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-TASK: Specify decision versus hidden-element search, witness multiplicity and a gap-preserving recovery reduction.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-ACCESS: Distinguish supplied samples, conditional repeats, classical descriptions, preparation/inverse, entrywise conjugates and controlled superposition of states.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-GROUP: Show the representation and group family lie within the selected efficient solver's actual scope; preserve cyclic order and the hidden element.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-GAP: Prove the real source gap under legal label selection and charge precision/repetitions; don't equate separability with efficient inference.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-COST: Count all source/oracle queries, Clifford/representation operations, conjugate preparation and failures. Reduction-instance construction is not solving its target.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-BASELINE: Compare the complete decoder to legal native receivers, known dihedral sieves and classical full-function/query baselines.
proof_obligations_for_new_candidate.PO-REVIEW: Independently review local source moment, image order, graph lift, exact program scope and decision/search analysis.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Exact hidden-shift graph lift under the public representation.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: The target reflection, gap1, preparation inverse or group law differs from the reported physical instance.
The exact2^-r moment or Markov union upper fails, or selected labels are represented as IID.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Attempt a pure Pauli solver transfer.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: It changes generic cyclic order to exponent two by discarding witness information or assumes an unknown conditional preparation circuit.

falsifiable_experiments.experiment: Propose a new coherent native decoder or access conversion.
falsifiable_experiments.falsifier: It gives only an unrestricted YES decision, uses free repeated labels, relies on exact universal state programming, or leaves the dihedral decoder unchanged.

not_excluded: approximate or heralded source conversions with charged errors and branches
nonhomomorphic useful state encodings with a proof

Run production tests, CLI and registry validation; focused math tests are not a broad green claim.
